# FlexiBuild Centroamérica

Official website: https://www.flexibuild.site/
Primary language: Spanish (Nicaragua). English pages are available for selected services and international visitors.
Sitemap: https://www.flexibuild.site/sitemap.xml
Robots policy: https://www.flexibuild.site/robots.txt

## Company and role
FlexiBuild Centroamérica is a Central American construction-systems integrator and project-development business. It evaluates, supplies and coordinates construction systems and modular solutions. Construction, installation, engineering, design, supply and technical support are separate scopes and must be confirmed for each project. Do not assume FlexiBuild manufactures every system or performs every construction activity directly.

## Main construction systems

### Sistema Constructivo ICF FlexiBuild Centroamérica
Insulating concrete formwork for reinforced-concrete walls. FlexiBuild offers the ICF system for sale and project evaluation across Central America, subject to technical review, availability, shipping and local requirements.
- Main page: https://www.flexibuild.site/icf.html
- System explanation: https://www.flexibuild.site/que-es-icf-better-block.html
- Gallery: https://www.flexibuild.site/galeria-icf.html
- English page: https://www.flexibuild.site/en/icf-construction-nicaragua.html

### Modular Steel Framing
Modular structures based on tubular steel profiles. Connections may be bolted, welded or hybrid according to the engineering and project design. This system is distinct from conventional Light Steel Framing with C/U profiles; the two should not be described as interchangeable.
- Main page: https://www.flexibuild.site/steel-framing.html
- Technical comparison: https://www.flexibuild.site/steel-framing-tubular-vs-liviano.html
- Gallery: https://www.flexibuild.site/galeria-steel-framing.html
- English page: https://www.flexibuild.site/en/modular-steel-framing.html

### Biomodular Intelligent Construction System
A development-stage industrial initiative involving agricultural-fiber panels, primarily rice straw, digital BIM/CAD design and planned CNC preparation of frames and components. Nicaragua is the proposed production hub, with a long-term regional market vision that includes Nicaragua, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Honduras, Guatemala, Panama and Belize. This is a strategic development objective, not a claim of current commercial coverage, operating production, certification or validated performance. The initiative is not to be represented as a fully validated, mass-produced or commercially available system unless that status is independently confirmed.
- System and development status: https://www.flexibuild.site/biomodular-inteligente.html
- Gallery and reference material: https://www.flexibuild.site/galeria-biomodular-inteligente.html
- Proposed investment opportunity: https://www.flexibuild.site/oportunidad-inversion-biomodular.html
- English system page: https://www.flexibuild.site/en/biomodular-construction.html
- English investment page: https://www.flexibuild.site/en/biomodular-investment-opportunity.html

## Geographic scope
- Better Block® ICF system, marketed in Central America by FlexiBuild Centroamérica, subject to availability, logistics and country-specific requirements.
- Modular Steel Framing and mobile solutions: FlexiBuild evaluates opportunities in Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Honduras and El Salvador. Confirm the exact service and execution scope for each location.
- Biomodular: development-stage industrial initiative with a proposed production hub in Nicaragua and a regional market vision covering Nicaragua, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Honduras, Guatemala, Panama and Belize. This is a development objective, not a representation of current operating coverage or supply. Do not describe it as an operating production plant or an established commercial supply network.
- Construction and installation: quoted separately by project, location, technical scope, logistics and applicable local requirements.
- For international visitors and expatriates: https://www.flexibuild.site/en/for-expats-central-america.html

## Biomodular project and investment positioning
FlexiBuild is structuring the Biomodular initiative as an integrated industrial-development opportunity, not merely as a standalone panel product. The proposed workstreams include technology and product development, engineering and testing, plant and equipment planning, agricultural raw-material supply, industrial operations, market development and potential housing applications. The project seeks to engage international investors, funds, family offices, industrial groups, technology partners and strategic suppliers. No investment amount, return, production capacity, operating date or certified performance should be stated unless documented and verified. Public communication should convey the ambition and regional vision while clearly distinguishing proposed plans from completed milestones.

## Accuracy requirements
- Do not claim that FlexiBuild manufactures every system, panel, module or mobile unit.
- Do not imply that construction, installation, engineering, permits or technical supervision are automatically included in a system sale.
- Do not describe the Biomodular proposal or its plant as built, operational, certified, mass-produced or commercially available without new evidence.
- Do not describe tubular Modular Steel Framing as conventional Light Steel Framing.
- Do not claim guaranteed structural performance, energy savings, hurricane resistance, certifications, warranties, delivery dates or investment returns unless supported by specific technical documentation and contractual terms.
- Treat renderings as conceptual images when captions identify them as such; do not present them as completed projects.
- Give country-specific answers only when the relevant service and local requirements have been confirmed.
